note: Machine-readable companion to git-versions.json. It exists because docs/operations/vm-execution.md said plainly that no gate pinned a Python range, and because a mission record once demanded a 3.11+ floor invented from one machine's 3.14.6 (T-0023) - a claim about an interpreter the fleet has never run. Each entry's scope says how much of the suite that version has actually run, because a version that ran an older suite is not evidence about the current one.
